verdict.rationale: Codegen's CLI can pull agent-created branches and code changes into your local environment, and its terminal UI lets you browse agents and runs. That gives a documented path to finish work locally. However, nothing shows taking over a task while it is still running, handing off into an editor or browser, or redirecting a live run beyond resuming paused runs via the API. missing for 10: explicit live-takeover of in-progress runs, editor/IDE handoff, browser-based takeover or redirect, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can take over an in-progress agent task in my editor, terminal, or browser to finish or redirect the work

citations.quote: Pull agent work - Download branches and code changes created by agents directly to your local environment
Use it to view agents, pull their work, create new agents
Launches the interactive terminal UI (TUI) for browsing agents, viewing runs, and managing your Codegen workflow from the terminal.
Resumes a paused agent run, allowing it to continue processing.
